description:
Implement platform-specific EXPLAIN output parsers that convert native query 
plans into harmonized QueryPlanDAG structure. Includes base parser interface
and 9 platform-specific implementations.

**Parsing Strategy**:
- Each platform provides EXPLAIN in different format (text trees, JSON, XML)
- Parse native format → intermediate representation → QueryPlanDAG
- Graceful degradation on parse failures (warn, continue without plan)
